summary: Two real issues were found and fixed in the security-review upgrade: the Morpho adapter accepted stale prices, and repay/liquidate updated state after token transfers. Everything else is intended fixed-point math, deliberate use of the Oracle's tuple, timestamps for price age, or known false positives in the generated verifier. This is automated analysis, not an audit.

findings.note: Ignored the price's update time, so a Morpho market could borrow or liquidate on an arbitrarily old price. The new adapter reverts on a missing price or one older than maxAge (1 day).

State was updated after token transfers. Not exploitable with Nightshift's tokens (no callbacks), but a hook-enabled token could re-enter. The new Vault updates state first and has a reentrancy guard on every state-changing function; a test with a malicious callback token confirms re-entry is refused.
A needless /WAD*WAD truncation in the seized amount; now a single division.
Intended 18-decimal fixed-point math and unit conversions. Rounding favours the protocol (proven as property V5); _price counts full hours on purpose for confidence decay.
debt == 0 means there is no loan, so health is unbounded. Intended.
Each reads only the fields of getPrice it needs (price and time, or confidence).
snarkjs verifiers return from inline assembly by design; a well-known Slither false positive for this template. Verified behaviour: valid proofs pass, tampered proofs fail (tests).
Timestamps measure price age (hours to days); a validator's few seconds of influence don't matter at that scale.
Event ordering after transfers is covered by the reentrancy guard; zero-address checks were added to the new adapters, feeds and registry.
Generated code, left as snarkjs emits it.

before.note: deployed contracts before the upgrade (3 High are the verifier false positive)

after.note: upgraded contracts: the Medium reentrancy findings are gone (one Low benign-reentrancy note remains on deposit, which is guarded); Medium items are the accepted cases above, counted per location
